test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The mean of ages of a group of 35 school students is 16 years. A 52 year old teacher joined the group. Find the mean of the ages of the students and the teacher.
solution:
**Given:**

The mean of ages of a group of 35 students = 16 years

Age of teacher = 52 years

**Formula used**:

Average = Sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

According to the question

The mean ages of 35 students = (35 × 16)

⇒ 560

A old teacher joined the group = (52 + 560)

⇒ 612

Now,

The total age of students and teacher = (35 + 1) = 36 

The mean ages of the students and teacher = (612/36)

⇒ 17

**∴ Required ages is 17 years**
